# googleworkspace_policies (Data Source)

Lists the Admin console settings (policies) that apply in the account, through the [Cloud Identity Policy API](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/concepts/overview-policies). Each policy is one setting applied to an organizational unit or group, so this shows what moving a user between units would change.

The Policy API is read-only for nearly all settings (Google marks only Data Protection rules and detectors as writable), so this is for inventory and drift detection rather than management. Not every Admin console setting is exposed; Gmail routing rules, for example, are not.

~> **Requirements:** the provider must use `service_account`, its domain-wide delegation must include `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-identity.policies`, and the Cloud Identity API must be enabled in its project. The token for this scope is separate, so other resources do not need it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_policies" "all" {}
data "googleworkspace_org_units" "all" {}

# Settings applied directly to each organizational unit (not inherited). An empty
# list means moving users into or out of that unit changes no exposed setting.
locals {
  local_settings = {
    for ou in data.googleworkspace_org_units.all.org_units : ou.org_unit_path => [
      for p in data.googleworkspace_policies.all.policies : p.setting_type
      if p.org_unit_id == ou.id && p.type == "ADMIN"
    ]
  }
}

data "googleworkspace_policies" "gmail" {
  filter = "setting.type.matches('gmail.*')"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Policy API [filter](https://cloud.google.com/identity/docs/reference/rest/v1/policies/list), e.g. `setting.type.matches('gmail.*')`. Omit to list every policy.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Matching policies, ordered by setting type, then organizational unit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String) Group the policy is applied to (`groups/...`), or null.
- `name` (String) Resource name, `policies/...`.
- `org_unit_id` (String) Organizational unit the policy is applied to, as `id:...` (matching `googleworkspace_org_unit.id`), or null when it applies through a group.
- `query` (String) The policy's full CEL targeting expression.
- `setting_type` (String) Setting identifier, e.g. `settings/security.two_step_verification_enforcement`.
- `sort_order` (Number) Precedence relative to other policies with the same setting type.
- `type` (String) `ADMIN` for settings an admin configured, `SYSTEM` for Google defaults.
- `value` (String) The setting's value as a JSON object.
